successCriteria.description: EmployeeService accepts an IAuditRepository dependency (in addition to its existing IEmployeeRepository) so that state-changing methods can write audit records

EmployeeService.create() writes an AuditRecord with entityType='Employee', action='CREATE', newValues containing the created employee's fields, and the entityId matching the newly created employee's id

EmployeeService.update() writes an AuditRecord with entityType='Employee', action='UPDATE', oldValues capturing the employee state before the update, newValues capturing the sanitized (allowlisted) fields applied, and entityId matching the updated employee's id

EmployeeService.terminate() writes an AuditRecord with entityType='Employee', action='TERMINATE', oldValues capturing the employee state before termination, newValues reflecting employmentStatus=TERMINATED and terminationDate set, and entityId matching the terminated employee's id

Every AuditRecord written by EmployeeService has a valid UUID for id, performedAt and createdAt set to the current timestamp, and uses crypto.randomUUID() for id generation — matching the pattern established by AuditService

constraints: The employee → audit cross-module dependency MUST import exclusively through the audit module's barrel export (src/modules/audit/index.ts) — no direct imports from audit.model.ts, audit.repository.interface.ts, or any other audit internal file
EmployeeService MUST NOT depend on IAuditService — it depends on IAuditRepository only, and constructs AuditRecord objects directly (matching the settled decision)
Audit writes MUST occur after the corresponding repository operation succeeds — if the repository call fails, no audit record is written (no phantom audit entries for failed operations)
The IEmployeeService interface (employee.service.interface.ts) MUST NOT change — the audit dependency is an implementation detail of EmployeeService and does not alter the public service contract
outOfScope: A concrete IAuditRepository implementation (e.g., a Postgres/Knex repository) — the audit module currently defines only the interface; the concrete implementation is deferred to a later phase
Unit tests for EmployeeService — tests are pending per PLAN.md and are not part of this phase

entityInvariants.invariant: Every AuditRecord written by EmployeeService MUST have entityType set to the literal string 'Employee'
The Employee entity's shape, fields, and lifecycle are unchanged by this phase — the audit integration is purely additive and does not alter Employee attributes or business rules

interfaceConstraints.authRule: N/A — constructor is not an API endpoint
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Must accept two parameters: IEmployeeRepository (existing) and IAuditRepository (new). Must store both for use in state-changing methods.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: N/A — auth is enforced at the controller/route layer
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: After a successful repository.create call, must call auditRepository.create with a fully constructed AuditRecord. If auditRepository.create fails, the employee has already been persisted — the error must propagate to the caller.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: N/A — auth is enforced at the controller/route layer
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Must fetch the existing employee before applying the update (to capture oldValues). After a successful repository.update call, must call auditRepository.create. If the employee is not found (null from findById), returns null without writing an audit record.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: N/A — auth is enforced at the controller/route layer
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Already fetches the existing employee (to check existence). After a successful repository.update call setting TERMINATED status, must call auditRepository.create. If the employee is not found, returns null without writing an audit record.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The AuditRecord objects constructed by EmployeeService MUST conform to the AuditRecord interface declared in src/modules/audit/audit.model.ts — all required fields (id, entityType, entityId, action, oldValues, newValues, performedBy, performedAt, createdAt) must be present with correct types

The IAuditRepository passed to EmployeeService MUST match the interface declared in src/modules/audit/audit.repository.interface.ts — specifically the create(record: AuditRecord): Promise<AuditRecord> method signature

The IEmployeeService interface in src/modules/employee/employee.service.interface.ts MUST remain unchanged — the audit dependency is an implementation detail of EmployeeService, not a change to the public contract

The employee.routes.ts wiring MUST be updated to pass an IAuditRepository instance to the EmployeeService constructor — the current signature `new EmployeeService(repo)` must become `new EmployeeService(repo, auditRepo)` or equivalent

integrationPoints.why: EmployeeService imports IAuditRepository and AuditRecord from the audit module's public barrel — this is the new employee → audit cross-module dependency
The wiring point where IAuditRepository is instantiated (or received) and passed to EmployeeService — this file must be modified to supply the second constructor argument
